designs.name: ดำตั้งปัดหลัง · Swept Spikes
designs.description: Original short upswept swept-back black hairstyle: exposed clean forehead, strong backward-flowing thick locks, asymmetrical radial crown with 6-8 pointed hooked tufts, short compact temples, one tapered temple lock each side, narrow forehead V hairline. Controlled medium-height crown: extend about 5 native pixels above original crown, silhouette tallest near center and bends backward; avoid a mohawk, flat cap or spherical fluffy wig. Bold connected dark shadow masses and directional grey-violet midtones, restrained highlights. Source pale muted lavender-silver for palette conversion, not pure white. Both original eyes and brows fully visible.

designs.name: แสกกลางกรอบหน้า · Golden Curtains
designs.description: Original warm golden-brown curtain hairstyle shape: precise central root split, two broad curved curtain wings flowing down diagonally, layered feathered cheek-length ends taper just below both ears, a small inverted V forehead opening, symmetrical overall mass with slight natural strand variation. Low rounded crown, medium length and controlled width, coherent large curved locks rather than many thin noisy lines. Tips follow both cheeks and flick gently inward, not a bowl bob, tall spikes or a wolf mullet. Source pale muted lavender-silver for recoloring into warm gold, not pure white. Both original eyes and brows visible; retain original ears/face.

scope: Two FRONT candidates only; no other directions until approval
